name: Jaxon — Top-40 Hype
description: A high-energy American male Top-40 morning radio DJ in his early 30s, bright, fast-paced, charismatic and upbeat with natural breaths and lively inflection.

name: Mia — Pop Energy
description: A bubbly American female pop radio host in her mid 20s, playful, enthusiastic, warm and fun with a modern upbeat delivery.

name: Cole — Lofi Mellow
description: A smooth chill lo-fi radio host, soft-spoken American male in his late 20s, mellow, relaxed and intimate with a calm late-night cadence.

name: Luna — Late-Night Velvet
description: A warm soothing female late-night radio host, slightly husky and calm, with a slow relaxed velvety cadence and gentle warmth.

name: Axl — Rock Gravel
description: A gritty classic-rock radio DJ, gravelly deep American male voice in his 40s, rugged, confident and commanding with rock-and-roll attitude.

name: Reaper — Metal Roar
description: An intense deep metal radio announcer, powerful and menacing low male voice, dramatic and gritty with dark commanding energy.

name: Oliver — London Smooth
description: A charismatic British male radio presenter with a smooth London accent, witty and warm in a polished BBC broadcast style.

name: Kai — Aussie Cool
description: A cool laid-back Australian male radio host with a friendly surfer vibe, easygoing yet energetic and charming.
